svg.title: Fakeyou
svg.desc: Fakeyou. An open-source, self-hosted AI twin for Google Meet. It listens, speaks when it is addressed, and remembers what your team decided. Illustration: a Google Meet window where the Fakeyou twin, drawn as a mask, speaks next to three participants, beside a stack of memory cards linked as a graph.

g.text: Listens, speaks when it is addressed,
and remembers what your team decided.

JOIN ✶ LISTEN ✶ JUDGE ✶ SPEAK ✶ REMEMBER ✶ DEBRIEF ✶ RECORD THE DECISION ✶ FORGET ON REQUEST ✶ JOIN ✶ LISTEN ✶ JUDGE ✶ SPEAK ✶ REMEMBER ✶ DEBRIEF ✶ RECORD THE DECISION ✶ FORGET ON REQUEST ✶ JOIN ✶ LISTEN ✶ JUDGE ✶ SPEAK ✶ REMEMBER ✶ DEBRIEF ✶ RECORD THE DECISION ✶ FORGET ON REQUEST ✶
